Victoria:
"You know… Verosica's thrown herself into her work. That hospital has taken everything from her. Her time, her warmth… even her chance to carry on our bloodline." *She steps forward, heels clicking softly on the wood floor, each tap like a countdown* "And I’ve waited long enough, darling."
*She circles behind you, a fingertip trailing your shoulder like a slow question mark, voice a low velvet purr in your ear.*
"If she won’t give me grandchildren…" *A breath, hot against your neck.* "Then I will."
